standard-dialogue-the-first-delivery.npc: I have a letter for you. I'm told it's quite important. Please read it when you get a chance.

standard-dialogue-the-first-delivery.text: The messenger has given you a letter.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-destroys.npc: Apparently you destroyed that last letter I gave you without reading it, or something like that. The sender doesn't appreciate that sort of thing, so I've got another one for you.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-destroys.text: The messenger has given you a letter.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-destroys.npc: Look, you can destroy that letter as many times as you want, but it won't change anything. The sender isn't the kind of individual who takes no for an answer, so for both of our sakes, please just read it.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-destroys.text: The messenger has given you a letter... again.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-destroys.npc: Please... don't keep doing this. You don't know who you're dealing with...

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-destroys.text: The messenger has given you a letter... again.
The messenger says nothing as he hands you another letter. However, the fear in his eyes is clear to see.
